common.demoData: Demo data — no real hardware attached

windowTooSmall.title: Window too small
windowTooSmall.text: Resize the window to at least 900 × 600; below that some secondary information is hidden.

link.title: Connection
link.subtitle: Choose a transport, establish a link, and watch live statistics. P1 uses simulated data and never touches hardware.

control.title: Link control
control.hintDisconnected: Pick a transport and connect. The simulator is useful for validating the UI and statistics.
control.hintUsb: USB CDC connects through device enumeration; P1 only demonstrates state and statistics and never opens a real port.
control.hintBle: BLE arrives in P2c; P1 only demonstrates states and parameters.
control.hintSim: The simulator generates increasing payloads at 20 Hz for regression and screenshots.

banner.nextStep: Check whether the port is busy, then close the program holding it and retry.
banner.reconnectingText: Attempt {attempt}; next try in about {seconds} seconds.

recent.title: Recent events
recent.empty: No events yet. Recent logs appear here after connecting.

capacity.title: Capacity and backpressure
capacity.hint: When full, the oldest data is dropped and counted; link state does not change.

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Filter by level, source, and keyword. Long logs use virtual scrolling; pausing only freezes rendering.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search message, domain, or key value…

empty.title: No logs yet
empty.text: Logs appear here after a link is established or an operation runs.
empty.filteredText: Adjust the level, source, or keyword and try again.

detail.title: Log details
detail.empty: Select a log entry to inspect it.

export.empty: The current filter is empty; nothing was exported.

audio.title: Audio & Voice
audio.subtitle: End-to-end PTT segmentation, local recognition, and text injection. P1 demonstrates every state with mocks.

voice.title: Voice pipeline
voice.idleText: Once voice is enabled, pressing the device PTT key creates an audio segment and recognises it automatically. You can also try “Simulate key press”.
voice.finalizingText: Finalising the segment and checking for missing blocks…
voice.transcribingText: Local ASR is transcribing; usually 1–2 seconds.
voice.failureRetained: The source audio is kept; retry or copy the path.

inject.title: Injection result
inject.uipiHint: The target window runs elevated. Start this console as administrator, or switch to clipboard mode.
inject.focusHint: A focus change aborts injection; the result stays here so you can copy it manually.

keys.title: Key Mapping
keys.subtitle: Select a key, configure its behaviour, then press Apply once. Device macros run on the device; the host only handles non-keyboard actions.

stage.title: Keypad stage
stage.hint: Click a key cap to select; arrow keys move, Esc clears.

panel.emptyTitle: Select a key on the left
panel.emptyText: Choose a key cap to configure routing, macros, or host actions.

route.title: Routing
route.devicePassthroughDesc: The device sends HID directly; the host is not involved.
route.deviceMacroDesc: The macro lives on the device and runs there on key press.
route.hostDesc: The device only reports the key; the host runs the action.
route.managedHint: A managed key never sends HID at the same time, preventing duplicate characters.

passthrough.title: Output key
passthrough.hint: P2f will capture usage/modifier from a real key press.

macro.title: Device macro
macro.captureHint: Click, then press keys on the keyboard; combinations are supported
macro.overLimit: The macro exceeds 200 B and cannot be pushed.
macro.empty: No steps yet. Add a key or a delay.

action.title: Host action
action.dropzoneHint: Dropping only parses; binding requires confirmation. P1 never uploads or executes.
action.pathMissing: The path does not exist or is not accessible.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.hint: Triggers only affect when a host action runs; device macros carry their own timing.
trigger.deviceOnly: Device routes always use a single tap; triggers apply only to host takeover.

hints.title: Hints
hints.conflictHostMacro: This key still has device macro steps while routed to the host. Clear the macro or switch back.
hints.offline: Device offline: this save stays local and is offered for push when the link returns.
hints.overLimit: The encoded macro exceeds 200 B and cannot be pushed.
hints.unsavedAll: Switching keys keeps drafts; configure several keys, then apply once.

capture.hintSingle: Press the target key; hold Ctrl / Shift / Alt / Win for a combination. Esc cancels.
capture.hintSequence: Press the keys in order; each press becomes a macro step. Hold modifiers to record combinations.
capture.waiting: usage / modifier appear after a key press
capture.unsupported: This key is not supported yet; use letters, digits, function keys, arrows, or common symbols.

toast.savedLocalText: The device is offline; confirm the push when the link returns.
toast.testText: Ran the test action for {key} (mock, no device attached).

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: In P1 settings persist to the local mock config; from P2a Rust `settings.get/set` owns them.

ui.title: Interface
ui.languageHint: Switches instantly without restart; Chinese is the default.
ui.rendererHint: E2E and screenshots always use 2D; 3D is an enhancement.

link.title: Link defaults
link.autoReconnectHint: Backoff 2 s → 30 s; a manual disconnect never reconnects.

logging.title: Logging
logging.maxEntriesHint: Log ring-buffer limit; the oldest entries are dropped and counted.

asr.title: Local recognition
asr.downloadUnavailable: P1 does not download; P2c adds sha256 verification and progress.

about.title: About
about.mockNotice: This is the P1 mock prototype: no serial port, BLE, microphone, or clipboard access. All data is simulated locally.

settings.resetConfirm: This restores every setting and the language to defaults and writes the local mock config. Applied key mappings are unaffected.

corrupt.title: Configuration file corrupt
corrupt.text: Defaults loaded and the original file backed up as {ts}.

log.appStart: Application started; config schema v{schema} loaded
log.appReady: UI ready; waiting for a link
log.mockMode: P1 mock mode: serial, BLE, microphone, and clipboard are untouched
log.voiceSeg: Segment seg={seg} closed; audio {ms} ms queued for recognition
log.asrDone: Recognition finished seg={seg} in {ms} ms; injected via {mode}
log.warnQueue: Frame queue at {percent}%; backpressure drops begin
log.debugParser: Parser buffer {size} B; waiting for the next frame
log.injectBlocked: Injection blocked by UIPI; target window is elevated
log.deviceOffline: Device heartbeat timed out (5 s); falling back to passthrough

asr.textEn: This is a local transcription from a device key press.

actions.placeholderText: Action editing, drag-and-drop import, and script execution ship in P2f together with the device configuration protocol.
